description: List money movements by The Standard Reserve (TSR) protocol on Robinhood Chain, newest first in chain order. Filter with kind: holdings_migrated, taxes_forwarded, fees_recycled, team_claimed, pol_buyback, pol_fees_collected, pol_paired, incentive_sent, or vault_outflow. A pol_paired row is ETH the PolManager added to the pool as protocol-owned liquidity after swapping part of it to STANDARD; eth_amount is the ETH committed. A vault_outflow row is value that left the multisig-held reserve vault, in ETH or an ERC-20 token, with the method that moved it. A batched Safe transaction gets one row per send, told apart by sub_index. Page with limit and cursor: pass next_cursor from the previous response. An unknown kind or a malformed cursor returns an error. eth_amount, std_amount and token_amount are integers as strings. Divide by the token's decimals (1e18 for ETH and STANDARD, 1e6 for USDG) or read the matching *_dec field.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: pass next_cursor from the previous response. A block:log_index:sub_index string is also accepted

kind.description: Flow kind to filter by: holdings_migrated, taxes_forwarded, fees_recycled, team_claimed, pol_buyback, pol_fees_collected, pol_paired, incentive_sent, or vault_outflow

name: 1s_std_protocol_flows
title: TSR Protocol Flows
